decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a cheap component improvement built on the existing infrared line, and with a narrow portfolio its option value is worth more than its small carrying cost.
It had its own page, which shows real commitment, and the 2022 gas-price shock makes its prospects uncertain rather than clearly failed, so keeping this low-cost line extension preserves the option.
This luminous radiant heater shares production and know-how with the core line, so carrying it costs little while the uncertainty about gas-fired heating is still unresolved.
Tube heaters are a core hall-heating offer, and with few alternative options the firm gains more by keeping it than by dropping it before demand under the energy crisis becomes clear.
The standard plaque heater is a prominent, low-cost product presented on its own page, and no evidence shows its value has failed to materialize.
It overlaps with tube heater D, so consolidation is somewhat more likely, but its low carrying cost and the unresolved market outlook still favor keeping it for now.
